convert_batch_matrix_to_pycolmap: convert batched PyTorch tensors to a PyCOLMAP Reconstruction object with camera and image data
convert_pycolmap_to_batch_matrix: convert a PyCOLMAP Reconstruction object back to batched PyTorch tensors for points, extrinsics, and intrinsics
build_pycolmap_reconstruction: build a PyCOLMAP Reconstruction from 3D points, extrinsics, intrinsics, tracks, and masks
extract_camera_intrinsics: extract camera intrinsics and extrinsics from a PyCOLMAP Reconstruction object
filter_valid_3d_points: filter 3D points by requiring at least two inlier observations across frames
